title: Evidence-Centered Visualization for ML Security Engineering
subtitle: Aggregating Repository-Level Measurements Into Traceable Technical Dashboards

cards.label: default configured repositories, not confirmed aggregation
REST API authentication in implemented path
recognized metrics from available sibling files

contribution: An evidence-centered dashboard server that aggregates committed per-repo JSON into traceable HTML + a token-authed REST API, deliberately surfacing weak results (e.g. ROC-AUC 0.54, OOD F1 0.72) alongside strong ones rather than curating highlights.
methods: Authenticate protected REST requests with the configured token.
Discover available JSON in supported evidence directories.
Extract recognized fields and return aggregate results.
Render static HTML examples separately; check each example against its cited inputs.
evidence: Cited Python 3.12 CI: 37 passed. No coverage percentage is asserted.
Eight repositories are configured by default; the number successfully aggregated depends on available sibling files.

The server discovers JSON under evidence, results, metrics, reports, output and repository root, and extracts recognized shallow fields. Static authored dashboard examples are not all dynamically sourced.
Prior sibling examples use dimensionless metrics: grouped F1 about 0.97, OOD F1 about 0.72, ROC-AUC about 0.54. These are example inputs, not new dashboard measurements.
limitations: Static evidence snapshots, not live monitoring.
Data can lag the current CI state of each repo.
Depends on sibling repos committing evidence.
Local aggregation; not a hardened service.
Not a live SOC monitor or hardened multi-user deployment; static snapshots can lag source CI.
reproduction: Install the documented development dependencies; run python -m pytest tests/ -q. Use the cited job configuration when reproducing coverage.
Benchmark data, adapters and environment requirements are separate; consult poster/13_reproducibility.md and the claim ledger.
